privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Planoka, we take the protection of your personal data very seriously. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information.

data.title: 1. Data collected
data.content: We collect information you provide directly: first name, last name, email address, phone number, city, interests and profile pictures. We also automatically collect usage data such as visited pages, interactions with plans and browsing preferences.

use.title: 2. Use of data
use.content: Your data is used to provide our services, personalize your experience, recommend relevant deals, improve our platform and contact you if needed. We never use your data for unauthorized purposes.

share.title: 3. Data sharing
share.content: We never sell your personal data to third parties. Your information may be shared with trusted service providers who help us operate the platform (hosting, analytics, notifications), subject to strict confidentiality guarantees.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies
cookies.content: We use cookies essential for the platform's operation, authentication cookies to manage your sessions, and analytics cookies to improve our services. You can manage your cookie preferences in your browser settings.

rights.title: 5. Your rights
rights.content: In accordance with Cameroonian data protection law, you have the right to access, rectify, delete and port your data. You can exercise these rights by contacting us at privacy@planoka.cm.

security.title: 6. Security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, modification, disclosure or destruction.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to Planoka. By using our platform, you agree to these terms of service. Please read them carefully.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
acceptance.content: By accessing or using Planoka, you confirm that you have read, understood and agree to be bound by these terms. If you do not accept these terms, please do not use our services.

account.title: 2. User account
account.content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials. You agree to provide accurate and up-to-date information. You must be at least 13 years old to use Planoka.

content.title: 3. Published content
content.content: By publishing a deal on Planoka, you guarantee that the information is accurate and that you have the necessary rights. You are solely responsible for the content you publish. Planoka reserves the right to remove any inappropriate content.

conduct.title: 4. User conduct
conduct.content: You agree not to use Planoka for fraudulent activities, spam, harassment or any other illegal activity. Failure to comply with these rules may result in the suspension of your account.

liability.title: 5. Limitation of liability
liability.content: Planoka acts as a matching platform and is not responsible for transactions or interactions between users. We do not guarantee the accuracy of information published by users.

modifications.title: 6. Modifications
modifications.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Users will be notified of material changes. Continued use of the platform after modifications constitutes your acceptance of the new terms.

contact.title: 7. Contact
contact.content: For any questions regarding these terms, please contact us at legal@planoka.cm or by mail at Douala, Cameroon.
